content.short: A social and analytical platform for Cardano NFTs.
content.description:
The journey started on October 2021 as a cnft collection, Avocado Breakfast Club, aiming an ambitious utility: creating a platform that unites everyone including investors, developers, artists and influencers. In line with this purpose, we started developing guacle and came to realize that social and analytical learning should come hand in hand for extensive decision making processes for both investors and developers. Therefore, we designed a mutually complementary structure for guacle.

Social side is built to provide user based ratings and discussions in a structured, organized and competitive way and it is completely free. Regarding analytical part, we're bringing comprehensive analytical approach to Cardano NFTs with the help of facts, metrics and charts covering Market Overview, Blue Chip Index, Smart Money, Latest Mints, Twitter Analytics, Project Metrics and Holder Metrics. Both parts are already published under the beta version and started operating.
